_comment: MUSA revenue catalogue. Prices are launch hypotheses — test them. 'volume' = units sold in month 1 under the BASE scenario; 'growth' = monthly multiplicative growth. Every product is deliberately structured so MUSA never charges a worker a placement/recruitment fee (that requires a BEOE OEP licence in Pakistan and a Department of Labour licence in Cyprus). Placement revenue only flows via licensed partners on an employer-pays basis.

products.name: Scam Shield (free message scan)
products.purpose: Top-of-funnel lead magnet; captures WhatsApp leads. Conversion to paid report ~5-8%.

products.name: Verify-Before-You-Pay Report
products.purpose: OEP licence + BEOE permission check, employer registry check, red-flag analysis, itemised cost sanity check. 48h delivery.

products.name: Deep Due-Diligence Case File
products.purpose: Everything in Basic + direct employer confirmation, work-permit reference check, contract review, payment-firewall decision, written case report.

products.name: Document & Attestation Concierge
products.purpose: HEC/IBCC/MOFA attestation guidance, EU-format CV, translation coordination. No document creation — only lawful preparation of genuine documents.

products.name: EU-format CV + Skills Match Profile
products.purpose: AI-generated Europass-style CV + match score against live Cyprus demand sectors. Builds the talent pool you later supply to licensed agencies.

products.name: MUSA Verified Recruiter badge (OEP subscription)
products.purpose: Licensed OEPs pay to be listed as verified in Scam Shield results + get Sentinel case tooling. Badge is revocable on any red-flag pattern.

products.name: Partner Platform Pro (white-label Sentinel)
products.purpose: MPP Tier 1 from the Meridian blueprint: case engine, risk scoring, cost ledger, branded reports.

products.name: Employer Sourcing Fee (via licensed partner)
products.purpose: Cyprus employer pays per pre-vetted candidate shortlisted. Contracted THROUGH a Department-of-Labour-licensed Cyprus agency and a BEOE-licensed OEP; MUSA earns a referral/tech share. Worker pays nothing to MUSA.

products.name: University placement commission
products.purpose: Institutions pay recruitment agents a share of first-year tuition (commonly 10-20%; verify each agreement). Requires a signed agent agreement per institution.

products.name: Cyprus Corridor Intelligence (monthly brief)
products.purpose: Monthly demand by sector, employer hiring signals, fee benchmarks, fraud-pattern alerts from the Reputation Graph.
